story: Sophie and her friend Mia are at the pet shop. There are three fluffy cats in the shop. One small orange cat is sleeping on a red chair. Sophie wants to put the cat in a big basket. Sophie picks up the basket. Mia holds the basket open. Sophie puts the sleepy cat inside the basket. The cat opens its green eyes! [emotion:QT/surprised] "The cat is awake!" Sophie says. [emotion:QT/happy] Mia and Sophie are laughing. [gesture:clapping] The lady at the shop gives the girls two cat treats to share.
